title: CHAP. II. I have si • ce written a Book on this subject, to which I refer the Reader for ful • er Direction. Directions to young Christians or Beginners in Religion, for their establishment and safe p

segments.text: BEfore I come to the Common Directions for the Exercise of Grace, and walking with God, containing the common duties of Christianity, I shall lay down some previous Instructions proper to those that are but newly entred into Religion, (presupposing what is said in my Book of Directions to those that are yet under the work of Conversion, to prevent their miscarrying by a false or superficial change.)
